system.description:
At 10th level, your style of combat casting becomes more refined, granting you a new ability based on your choice at level 1.

Defensive

Allies within your threatened area also gain a +1 bonus to AC if you are wearing magical armor or are under the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.ip8c3zrbrngrx1oe]{Mage Armor} spell.

Deflector

When you use your deflecting ability, the bonus lasts until the start of your next turn.

Long Range

When you cast a cantrip at a target who is at least 60ft away, you may spend your bonus action to recover 1 exertion if you have no exertion remaining.

Offhand

When you cast a cantrip while threatened, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your proficiency modifier until the end of your next turn.

Overwhelming

You may reroll any 1 or 2 on a cantrip’s damage die roll, taking the second result.

Spellbinding

Creatures that fail their saving throws against your cantrips cannot take bonus actions on their next turn.No description available.
